overview_description.description: CircuitHub provides on-demand electronics manufacturing services focused on printed circuit board assembly and rapid hardware production workflows. The company offers automated quoting, component sourcing, PCB fabrication, assembly management, and order tracking through a web-based platform that integrates with electronic design automation files. Its manufacturing system supports prototype builds, low-volume production, and batch manufacturing for hardware development teams working in robotics, aerospace, automotive, and industrial electronics. CircuitHub also develops software-driven factory processes and inventory management tools that help customers manage parts procurement, production status, and design iteration cycles.

about_short_description.short_description: CircuitHub provides on-demand electronics manufacturing services for printed circuit board assembly and hardware production workflows.

product.name: Software-Driven Electronics Manufacturing Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that automates PCB fabrication and assembly by integrating design files directly with manufacturing processes.

product.name: 3-Day Prototype PCB Assembly Service
product.description: A rapid PCB assembly service for low to mid complexity 2-4 layer boards, delivering fully assembled prototypes within three days.

product.name: Mid-Volume PCB Production Service
product.description: A manufacturing service for mid-volume PCB production runs using partner factories integrated with CircuitHub's platform to ensure consistent quality and process control.

product.name: Advanced Parts Sourcing and Logistics
product.description: A parts sourcing service integrated with the manufacturing platform that provides instant quoting and options for custom sourcing or consignment.

product.name: Workspaces Collaboration Feature
product.description: A collaboration tool within the CircuitHub platform that enables organized sharing and management of design assets among teams and external partners.
